record.display: I want to unify the UI style for all plugins in the Pneutrino series, including this one, check the UI for another plugin: PluginEditor.ccp and .h in [workspace]\Dynamic Resonator\Source, study its formats, including how the theme color is applied, how the knobs are styled, which fonts are used, the heading and attribution. I want the theme color for this plugin to be #FFBA22
Make the controls more horizontally compact, then box the four knobs and text button (main panel) with a 2.5px thick 10px rounded corners hollow rectangle, like with Dynamic Resonator.

Extreme Shifter is a plugin under NeutronStar714's Pneutrino series, in which I want to unify the UI styling in all plugins. Here's the source of another plugin in the series, Dynamic Resonator: [workspace]\Dynamic Resonator\Source. Study its UI styling, including knobs, fonts, fontSizes, textbuttons, rectangular boxes, header & attribution, and apply it to Extreme Shifter. Remember that Extreme Shifter has its own theme color, you don't take it from Dynamic Resonator, but instead learn how the theme color is used on the knobs, rectangular boxes etc.

Go on with the UI, to meet Pneutrino conventions, study the UI styling of another plugin in the series: Dynamic Resonator, which is at [workspace]\Dynamic Resonator\Source, apply the style of knobs, coloring, fonts, fontSizes, header & attribution and so on. The theme color for this plugin is #CCF1FF
